function toast(t){const el=$('#toast');el.textContent=t;el.classList.remove('hidden');clearTimeout(window.__tt);window.__tt=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.add('hidden'),2500)}
function logo(){return `<div class="logo"${logoData?` style="background-image:url(${logoData})"`:''}></div>`}
function appReady(){try{window.AndroidBora?.appReady?.()}catch{}}
function nativeNotify(payload){try{window.AndroidBora?.notifyUpdate?.(JSON.stringify(payload||{}))}catch{}}
async function failScreen(msg){$('#root').innerHTML=`<div class="loading"><div class="login-card"><div class="brand">${logo()}<div><h1>Bora Michael Hi Hi</h1><p>Sistema de entregas</p></div></div><h2>Não foi possível carregar</h2><div class="notice">${esc(msg||'Verifique sua conexão e tente novamente.')}</div><button class="btn gold" style="width:100%;margin-top:14px" onclick="location.reload()">Tentar novamente</button></div></div>`}
window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>console.error(e.reason));

 $('#root').innerHTML=`<section class="login"><div class="login-card"><div class="brand">${logo()}<div><h1>Bora Michael Hi Hi</h1><p>Painel administrativo</p></div></div><h2>Entrar no painel</h2><label class="field"><span>Login</span><input id="login" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="4" placeholder="0000"></label><label class="field" style="margin-top:10px"><span>Senha</span><input id="pin" type="password" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="4" placeholder="••••"></label><button id="enter" class="btn gold" style="width:100%;margin-top:14px">Entrar</button><div id="lmsg" class="msg"></div></div></section>`;

 $('#enter').onclick=go;$('#pin').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')go()};
}
